# Canadian Power Platform Summit 2027 (CPPS)

> CPPS is a non-profit, community-run conference celebrating innovation, collaboration, and all things Microsoft Power Platform — "The True North Power Platform Experience." The 2027 edition returns to Vancouver, BC on March 13, 2027, right before the Microsoft MVP Summit. The Call for Speakers is closed; the first round of speakers is being announced.

## Event details

- Name: Canadian Power Platform Summit 2027 (CPPS 2027)
- Dates: March 13, 2027
- Venue: Microsoft Vancouver, 1090 W Pender St, Vancouver, BC V6E 0E3, Canada
- Format: In-person, a full day of expert-led sessions and networking
- Organizer: Canadian Power Platform Summit (non-profit)
- Topics: Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Power BI, Power Pages, AI & agents

## Get involved

- Sponsorship enquiries: sponsors@canadianpowerplatformsummit.com
- General enquiries: info@canadianpowerplatformsummit.com
